prompt: The round counter at the top of the screen reads 3-2. You have 33 gold and 80 HP. A friend says items drop next round, so you should spend now. Read the clock: what round is this, and when does the next free thing actually arrive?

options.label: Stage 3, round 2. The carousel (a free unit with an item) is two rounds away at 3-4 and the monster round that drops items is at 3-7. Nothing drops next round
Stage 2, round 3. The next carousel is 2-4, so items come next round
Round 32 of the game. Items drop whenever you win a fight, so win this one

explanation:
The first number is the stage, the second is the round inside it: 3-2 is stage 3, round 2. Every stage has seven rounds. Rounds 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 are fights against other players, round 4 is the carousel where every player picks a champion holding an item, and round 7 is against monsters and drops items or gold. So from 3-2 the next free thing is the carousel at 3-4, and the monster loot is at 3-7. Next round, 3-3, is just another player fight.

This matters for your gold: 33 gold at 3-2 becomes 50 by 3-5 if you hold, and nothing in the next two rounds forces you to spend. Items never drop for winning a player fight; they come from monster rounds, the carousel and augments. Read the clock before every spend so you know how many rounds your gold has to last.
principle: Stage-round: seven rounds a stage, carousel at x-4, monsters at x-7. Know which comes next before you spend.
commonMistake: Spending at 3-3 because 'something drops next round', when the next drop is the 3-4 carousel and the next items are at 3-7.
hint: Split the number into stage and round, then count which rounds of a stage are fights, which is the carousel and which is the monster round.
